title: Edmonton River Valley 90-Minute Segway Adventure
includes: Cold beverages, coffee, snacks, and homemade goodies from our Urban Green Cafe (not included)
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
A maximum of 10 people per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: On this 90-minute Segway tour of Edmonton, Alberta, you will receive in-depth training from a certified Segway trainer. After the training, get ready for the experience of a lifetime as you ride through Edmonton’s world famous river valley.
